column1: # The SVG 2 properties the style layer knows by name: every property of the CR's property index (Appendix H), of its
# presentation attribute list (chapter 6.6) and of the other modules the chapters take (transform, mask, filter ...).
# tools/svg2/gen-tables.py reads this file with those two pages and fails when a property of either page is not here
# (so a page that grows is noticed), then writes include/ghoti.io/vector/svg_prop.h, src/codec/svg/style/svg_prop_tables.[ch]
#   name      the property, as the registry of `text` spells it.
#   type      how gvec_svg_get() reads it: KEYWORD (the computed value as text), NUMBER, LENGTH (user units), COLOR, PAINT,
#             DASHARRAY, TRANSFORM, REFS (url() references, `none`, or other values kept as text), SHORTHAND (no value of
#             its own; its longhands are read).
#   basis     the percentage basis of a LENGTH: W (the width of the nearest viewport), H (its height), D (the normalised
#             diagonal sqrt((w*w + h*h)/2)), - (none: the computed value is already absolute).
#   reads     the registry property read for the value, when it is not the property itself (a shorthand's longhand, an alias's target).
#   source    how the registry has it: G (the pin's definition stands), R (registered: the pin lacks it), O (overridden: the pin's
#             definition differs from the CR's, or cannot decide a value; the next three columns define it).
#   inherits  for R and O: yes or no (the CR's "Inh." column).
#   initial   for R and O: the initial value, as the CR gives it.
#   grammar   for R and O: the value in the Value Definition Syntax.
#   note      why, and the sentence of the specification that decides it.
# An override is reported: gvec_svg_style_context_override_at() lists them, and documentation/properties.md quotes the note.

column9: SVG 2 CR, Appendix H: `auto | optimizeSpeed | optimizeQuality`, initial `auto`, inherited. The served drafts dropped the property; browsers still accept it, and it never changes the picture.
CSS Fill and Stroke 3's <paint> has no <color> (`fill: red` is invalid by the pin); SVG 2 section 13.2: "<paint> = none | <color> | <url> [none | <color>]? | context-fill | context-stroke".
SVG 1.1 section 10.7.3 (deprecated in SVG 2, still a presentation attribute of the CR's list): `<angle>`, initial 0deg, inherited.
The pin's text is not a definition (the property has no grammar); SVG 2 CR Appendix H: `auto | <angle> | <number>`, initial `auto`, inherited.
The pin gives the property no initial value (and does not say whether it inherits); SVG 2 CR Appendix H: initial `black`, not inherited.
The pin gives the property no initial value; SVG 2 CR Appendix H: initial 1, not inherited.

SVG 2 CR section 13.5.3: `stroke-linejoin: miter | miter-clip | round | bevel | arcs`, initial `miter`, inherited. CSS Fill and Stroke 3 (the pin) spells the clipped miter `crop`, so `miter-clip` is invalid by the pin.

CSS Fill and Stroke 3 makes it a comma separated list, one width for each stroke layer, and adds the <line-width> keywords; SVG 2 section 13.3 and the browsers take one <length-percentage> or <number>, and a list is invalid.
